- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Recovery Clarification Headline: Updates sign-in headline and body to explicitly reassure returning users that signing into their account restores their previously saved desktop pet. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign_in copy changes have a proven track record (+1.4% win rate).)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Placement Readiness Display: Adds progress tracking and engine initialization status copy explaining desktop rendering setup while waiting. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to show on desktop or the app stalling, while home step wait_info updates consistently improve conversion (+1.6% win rate).)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Pre-Adoption Check Screen: Inserts a dedicated verification screen before certificate generation to inspect pet traits and rendering health. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or bad visual results during adoption.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Interaction Helper Screen: Adds an onboarding finish step screen explaining desktop pet controls and tray menu interactions. (why: 3 support emails specifically noted post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery Verification Hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint informing returning users how to retrieve saved desktop pets. (why: 8 support emails concerned missing pets after re-login; sign_in copy and hint optimizations consistently perform well.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Engine Load Status Display: Adds explicit step counter and status details for system tray overlay registration while the pet app launches. (why: 3 support emails reported desktop pet display glitches or launch stalls. Home wait_info updates consistently win.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Instant Companion Path Expectation Copy: Clarifies time expectations and path differences on the choose_path screen. (why: Choose_path has a high mean time (514s vs 8s median), showing users get stuck weighing options without clear expectation copy.)
